schema.survey_title: Neo Smart Living — Tahoe Mini Survey (High-Priority Version)
schema.description:
- **Target population:** Homeowners in Southern California with outdoor/property space where a factory-built unit could potentially be installed.
- **Mode:** Online self-administered survey. The targeted region can be expanded to the whole US to have enough online panel samples.
- **Estimated LOI:** 7–8 minutes
- **Primary output:** Direct answers to Research Objectives 1–3 (RQ1–RQ12)
- **Questions:** ~28 items
- **What was cut:** Outdoor space profiling (S4–S6), use-case matrix (Q4), category context (Q0a, Q0c), forced-choice barrier/value driver (Q6, Q18), additional value drivers (Q17b, Q17c), HOA status (Q24), outdoor club membership (Q26), sponsorship module (Q19–Q20), B2B module (Q27–Q29), conversion funnel (CM1–CM7), open-end/source (Q31–Q32)
